name: Owner-operator

masthead.lede: Fourteen questions about where your week goes, in your own words. Nothing technical. Talk into your phone if that’s easier — tap the microphone on your keyboard. Your answers save as you go, so stop whenever; the link brings you back.
howto: One question at a time. Tap Next when you’re done with each.
Tell me what actually happened — “last Tuesday” beats “usually.”
Don’t worry about fixes. That’s my job. Just tell me what eats the day.
masthead.after: When you’re done, I read it within two business days and send you one page: what I heard, and the two or three things we could build first.
masthead.callOption: I’d rather do this on a call with {consultantFirst}

finishText: That’s all fourteen. Nothing has been sent yet — the button below turns your answers into a plain text note you can send to {consultantFirst}, or just tap Print. Either way, you’ll hear back within two business days.
